serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Someone’s calling me…
You: Hello?
Lady Annalie: It’s me, Annalie~ How are you two doing?
You: Everything’s fine. How about you?
Lady Annalie: Alright! Today was an exciting day! 
You: Oh, really? What happened? 
Lady Annalie: Melissa came to my shop!
I guess Melissa made up her mind, that's good news.
You: I hope you weren’t bothering her too much.
Lady Annalie: How rude! Of course I was! You should know me this much already!
…
I hope Melissa is alright…
Lady Annalie: Anyway, her makeover has been completed~ That’s why I would want to invite you all so I can brag a little about it~
You: Wouldn’t normally the person getting the makeover brag about it? 
Lady Annalie: Nonsense! I did most of the work, so the bragging rights belong to me! 
You: I guess that makes a little sense.
Lady Annalie: I also wanted to ask about Melissa. Did you talk with her after that whole bastard cops incident?
You: I did. Why are you asking?
Lady Annalie: Mhmm~ No reason~
You: Come on, tell me. You already started the topic.
Lady Annalie: Oh well, it’s just that she seems a little more cheerful~ {{wi}}maybe. {{Wi}}Maybe! 
You: That’s good to hear!
You: Anyway, where do you want to go?
Lady Annalie: How about the cafe? The same as usual? I’m kinda tired of getting sweaty with you guys. All that bowling and singing is tiring! 
You: Sure, count us in!
Lady Annalie: See you later, then! Bye~
